function first<T>(map: { [key: symbol]: T }): T {
  return map[Symbol.for('x')];
}
console.log(first({ [Symbol.for('x')]: 2 }).toFixed(1));

const entries: { [key: symbol]: string } = { [Symbol.for('x')]: 'abc' };
console.log(first(entries).toUpperCase());

function values<T>(map: { [key: string]: T }): T[] {
  return Object.values(map);
}
const tag = Symbol('tag');
const total = values({ a: 1, b: 2, [tag]: 'ignored' }).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
console.log(total);

function atOne<T>(map: { [key: number]: T }): T {
  return map[1];
}
console.log(atOne({ 1: 'one', 2: 'two' }).length);

const typed: { a: number; b: number } = { a: 3, b: 4 };
console.log(values(typed).map((value) => value * 2));
